initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN r14306, represented by git commit bfae89f160d2798001c532d9b7287299aa6ea82b, whose subject explicitly included GF#16977 and whose publisher changes made datatype-page diagram links relative to the active datatype page.
additional_context: The old publisher generator source touched by r14306 is no longer checked into this repository, but the current datatype source pages and fhir.ini mappings remain active inputs. The current CI build output confirms the corrected behavior on datatypes-definitions.html.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current generated Datatypes Index on datatypes-definitions.html contains datatypes-definitions.html fragment links and no datatypes.html datatype links, so editing source would be redundant.
